evidence.V1: Four posts with gold ball finials, arched headboard, mattress, pillow and blanket read as a bed from front, three-quarter, top and silhouette.
evidence.V2: Big (frame + mattress), medium (arched headboard, footboard, blanket, pillow), small (gold finials, blanket fold band) hierarchy is clear.
evidence.V3: Arched headboard and fat pillow are stylised, but the corner posts are plain square boxes and the blanket is a flat slab with a boxy fold, so it reads partly primitive.
evidence.V4: Consistent soft chamfers catch light on the headboard arch, pillow ends, blanket fold edge and post tops.
evidence.V5: Close-ups of pillow, headboard and blanket fold show smooth shading with no pinches, seams or z-fighting; X symmetry 0.0.
evidence.V6: Wood frame in 2-3 values, cream bedding, one fabric hue (blanket) in two values, gold finials; disciplined.
evidence.V8: Vertex-coloured wood + one fabric hue, kit cream and gold, chamfered edges consistent with the furniture kit.
evidence.V9: Anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre; A1-A18 pass.

top_fixes: Give the corner posts a turned or tapered profile (or a cap/foot step) instead of plain square boxes
Soften the blanket into a draped shape that hangs over the mattress sides with a rounded fold
Add a slight sag/puff to the mattress top so the bedding reads less like stacked boxes
